import os
from urllib.parse import urlencode
from urllib.request import Request, build_opener, HTTPRedirectHandler

class NoRedirect(HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        return None

query = {}
url = "https://api.oddswire.io/v1/account/coverage" + ("?" + urlencode(query) if query else "")
request = Request(url, headers={"X-API-Key": os.environ["ODDSWIRE_API_KEY"]})
with build_opener(NoRedirect).open(request, timeout=25) as response:
    print(response.read().decode())

curl --get --max-time 25 \
  --url "https://api.oddswire.io/v1/fixtures/$FIXTURE_ID" \
  --data-urlencode "namespace=regional" \

import re
import os
from urllib.parse import urlencode
from urllib.request import Request, build_opener, HTTPRedirectHandler

class NoRedirect(HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        return None

fixture_id=os.environ["FIXTURE_ID"]
if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}",fixture_id):
    raise ValueError("Invalid fixture ID")
query = {"namespace": "regional"}
url = "https://api.oddswire.io/v1/fixtures/{fixture_id}".replace("{fixture_id}", fixture_id) + ("?" + urlencode(query) if query else "")
request = Request(url, headers={"X-API-Key": os.environ["ODDSWIRE_API_KEY"]})
with build_opener(NoRedirect).open(request, timeout=25) as response:
    print(response.read().decode())

post.description: Outgoing user-configured receiver contract, not a callable Oddswire API route. Verify HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + period + exact raw body using the base64url-decoded target secret and a 300-second timestamp tolerance; durably deduplicate verified body id before 2xx. At-least-once retries preserve body/event/delivery IDs with fresh timestamp/attempt. Six attempts maximum, earlier freshness/kickoff expiry, no redirects. Current access and alerts-purpose rights required; no external origin enabled by default.

200.description: Receiver durably deduplicated and accepted the event.

202.description: Receiver durably deduplicated and enqueued the event.

204.description: Receiver accepted an event, including an already processed duplicate.

X-Oddswire-Credit-Cost.description: Account-scoped admission snapshot where authenticated: remaining excludes holds; used counts settled calls. Cost 1 reserves one credit; actual charge settles only after completed response delivery. Inspect free account/usage by request ID for final state. UTC reset is RFC3339; overage is off. Unknown credentials disclose no account counters.
